title: Cover MCP write transaction diagnostics and cached-store mutex wiring end to end
outcome: Cover MCP write transaction diagnostics and cached-store mutex wiring end to end
acceptance: An ordinary MCP diagnostics test sends a real write word through McpServer::call_tool with full capture and asserts a work_mutation transaction record carrying the observed request ID/sequence and selected-store fingerprint, plus a cached-store mutex observation from the service path.
